note:
USACE campground on Lake Shelbyville.  Multiple sites are directly on the lakeshore.  --AWH
On the east shore in oak-hickory woods, with a swimming beach and a marina next door. C-loop sites 055-060 sit just above a sandy cove; elsewhere the banks are steep and the water is hard to reach from many sites. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov record, rates and catalog read: USACE, 104 electric sites (50 A at 100), full hookups at 37, 25-100 ft, 6 pull-throughs; $18 ($24 full hookup; 2026, 2027); 100% reservable, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14 in 30; showers, flush toilets, dump, water. Groups written manual; AWH note kept, a --Claude line added. Waterfront --AWH lakefront: measurements AGREE (C-loop 055-060 4-6 m over pool, 25-40 m). Pin inside the D loop, ~295 m from centroid: keep.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, --AWH 'Multiple sites are directly on the lakeshore': not changed): measurements SUPPORT it. C-loop sites on the cove: 059 (39.432132,-88.767595) pad 187.7 m, pool (182.8 m) at ~25 m; 060 (39.432496,-88.767708) ~32 m; 056 (39.432424,-88.766924) and 057 (39.432354,-88.767073) ~37 m; 055 (39.432526,-88.766802) ~40 m: 4-6 m above summer pool on a gentle slope, and imagery shows open sand at the cove below 055-057/059/062. All are ordinary nightly reservable sites. The other tagged sites are weaker: B 031-033 8-9 m above, water 40-55 m through canopy; A 012/013 ~10 m above, 42-50 m; A 007-009 12-14 m above, 95-100 m (view at best); D 072 14 m above, ~40 m; 073/074 70-80 m. rec.gov notice: 'The banks are steep and it may be difficult to get to the water from many sites.'
